ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Thinking, Reasoning, and Problem-Solving An overview of research on thinking, reasoning, and problem-solving. Topics will include creativity and insight, problem-solving through analogy, logic and other systems of reasoning, models of decision-making and choice, and fast and frugal decision-making strategies. First Year Discovery Program and James Scholars course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. https://netfiles.uiuc.edu/dcummins/www/HomePage/index.html *Meets w/PSYC 199, Section: DC, CRN: 49672
